summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2K.4 (analysis/authorization only, no real effect) re-derived the HATP prerequisite DAG fresh from real post-149O.20L.7O.2K.4-entry host state on hac-dell, all reads read-only via SSH and production readers: deployed revision 305f8e7913bac76941dade6ff4e018c74533f062 unchanged and clean; exactly one CertificationRecord (certification_id=2e5f861249d8e70bff53ba2f371d84e37e14eff0bbfcd939902fa7b47d236bd7, status=active) confirmed structurally and semantically consistent; certification-bindings.json confirmed ABSENT (no active binding); registry.json (Principal/Signer) and the hardware-credential-store root confirmed absent; deployment-bindings.json confirmed absent. Reconstructed the exact activate ceremony from HMIC-001 v1.6 sec.23-35 and scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py source directly (never from phase summaries): activate() writes only certification-bindings.json, never mutates CertificationRecord, requires exact certification_id plus fresh explicit confirm=True, and its only precondition is structural existence/parse, never a VALID check. HMIC-001 sec.35 (HMIC-REQ-118-127) was read directly and confirmed dispositive: HMIC certification activation has no dependency on Trust-Enrollment data (Hardware/Principal/Signer) and no dependency on Class-B compliance, in either direction -- confirmed by source-level absence of any such reference in activate() and by HMIC-001's own explicit non-causation requirements. Re-derived FIDO2/Principal/Signer/DeploymentBinding's exact 12-step first-use ordering from HPSE-001 sec.19 (HPSE-REQ-046) directly, and confirmed hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py's create_deployment_binding requires principal_id and signer_key_id as explicit CLI arguments (source-verified), fixing Principal-before-Signer-before-DeploymentBinding ordering. Re-verified the admin-entrypoint gap first reported by 2K: scripts/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py and scripts/hatp_principal_signer_admin.py still do not exist as standalone scripts/*.py entrypoints -- but this phase found and documented a distinction 2K's own report did not draw: the underlying library writer functions (register_credential/enroll_principal/enroll_signer/etc.) already exist at src/pcae/core/hatp_hardware_credential_admin.py and src/pcae/core/hatp_principal_signer_admin.py, with no CLI/argparse wrapper -- a genuine, contract-motivated (HHCE-REQ-019/020, HPSE-REQ-028/029: writer must be a separate, non-agent-writable, out-of-band admin tool) structural blocker distinct from 'the feature is unimplemented'. Built a corrected 8-node current DAG (CertificationRecord/activation, FIDO2 enrollment, Principal, Signer, DeploymentBinding, Class-B COMPLIANT, mandatory readiness, HATP activation) with no cycle, and selected exactly one next real-effect node by verifying (not assuming) that Candidate A's (HMIC certification activation) sole predecessor -- a structurally existing, parseable CertificationRecord -- is satisfied, while Candidate B's (FIDO2) predecessor chain is demonstrably not (admin-entrypoint gap plus unknown physical device presence, deliberately not probed this phase per the governing prompt's own read-only-precheck-or-classify-unknown option). Froze an exact, bounded authorization envelope for a future activation-only phase (bind certification_id=2e5f861249d8e70bff53ba2f371d84e37e14eff0bbfcd939902fa7b47d236bd7 only; explicit prohibitions on new-record creation, revocation, Trust-Enrollment state, DeploymentBinding, and HATP activation; exact command, read-only prechecks, required fresh Protected Admin election, required fresh human confirmation, post-binding validator re-check discipline, idempotency/conflict/failure-recovery classification) -- not executed. Class-B's own ad hoc re-run this phase (sudo -u pcae env -i with a minimal PATH) produced a numerically different result (31/34, NON_COMPLIANT) than 2K.3's canonical precedent-invocation value (32/33, sole residual HBDC-REQ-042); this divergence is attributed to this phase's own SSH-invocation environment (partial ACL-tooling PATH under env -i) rather than real state drift, since every input that diagnostic reads (deployed revision, Protected Root, all touched files) was independently confirmed byte-identical to 2K.3's own re-verification this same phase -- 2K.3's canonical value is relied upon as still current, and this document does not treat its own ad hoc re-run as authoritative. 10 new phase-local tests exercise activate()'s confirmation-gate/structural-precondition/idempotency/overwrite behavior against isolated tmp_path fixture roots (mirroring the existing 149O.19.5E suite's env fixture exactly, never touching production/host state) plus DAG cycle-absence and selected-node-uniqueness assertions -- all pass. fast_green A/B classification (isolated git worktree at this phase's exact entry commit 506f6b5f vs. the phase tree, both deselecting the 3 pre-existing fido2-import collection-error modules confirmed present on both trees): baseline 333 failed/8219 passed/7 skipped/9 errors; phase tree 334 failed/8228 passed/7 skipped/9 errors -- the +1 failed/+9 passed delta resolves to exactly this phase's own 10 new tests (10 pass) plus exactly one attributable false-positive substitution (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7n_1_..._verification.py::TestCandidateCurrentness::test_head_equals_origin_main, a literal HEAD==origin/main comparison that fails only because this phase's own commits are locally ahead pre-push, and will pass once pushed) -- zero real regressions.
